ideas.pitch: Real-time coastal water quality and marine hazard monitoring platform using computer vision and satellite telemetry.
ideas.title: MiamiSeaGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the local Miami setting by tackling marine and coastal environment monitoring, appealing directly to regional environmental judges and local civic tech interests.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered maritime logistics and cargo throughput predictor to optimize container turnaround times at PortMiami.
ideas.title: PortFlow Miami
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on a major local economic driver (PortMiami), making the live demo immediately relevant and impressive to judges connected to regional commerce and infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: Hyper-local tidal flooding and storm surge impact forecaster providing automated risk scoring for waterfront real estate.
ideas.title: AquaProphet Miami
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses an urgent, highly localized Miami vulnerability (sea level rise and flooding), ensuring strong emotional and practical resonance with the judging panel.

ideas.pitch: Mobile-first AR species identification and invasive species tracker tailored for South Florida's unique Everglades and coastal ecosystems.
ideas.title: BiscayneBio ID
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs a polished, camera-first mobile workflow that delivers a reliable, high-impact live demo.

ideas.pitch: Automated coral health diagnostic tool using underwater photo classification to assist marine conservation divers in Biscayne Bay.
ideas.title: ReefRescue AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines computer vision with environmental science, targeting judges looking for socially and ecologically impactful technology applications.
